I will spread some compost and household ash on the mounds to give the roots strength, and I will plant cuttings from last season’s harvest because improved stems are scarce and expensive. With the rains coming steady in this humid area, I do not need to irrigate, and for such a small plot my children and I can manage the clearing, planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without paying laborers.
